title: Should AI Decide Your Court Case? This Judge Says Yes
summary: One of England’s top judges, Geoffrey Vos, believes that AI could adjudicate plenty of civil cases. The question, he says, is where the line should be drawn.
reason: Wired story reports a judge's personal opinion that AI could adjudicate civil cases. It is commentary, not a new law, executive order, regulatory enforcement, or official policy announcement, so rule 4-1 is unmet; no other rule covers opinion commentary.
